tools.name: illustrate_financing
tools.description: Illustrate a monthly note the way the finance page does. Pass price, down, aprPercent, and months. Returns the principal, the formula payment, and the rounded dollars the page shows. Arithmetic only. Not a credit offer, not a rate lock, and not a promise a lender will take the deal. Taxes, freight,

tools.name: screen_truck
tools.description: Screen a truck the way the sell page does. Starts from that class band in the autumn 2026 price book, adjusts for year, hours, grade, and whether the power is known, then returns a low, a point, and a high. A screen, not an appraisal and not a bid. Year on the form runs from 1998 to 2026. Grade is A

tools.name: list_price_bands
tools.description: List the autumn 2026 used forklift price bands from the price book. Observed US independent listing ranges. Not inventory and not offers. Optional fuel filter: LP, Electric, Diesel, or Mixed.

tools.name: get_price_band
tools.description: One class from the price book, by id. Same band, capacity, and hours note as the book page. Not an offer.

tools.name: list_walkaround_checks
tools.description: The walk-around checks on the method page, in the same order. The desk uses these before an introduction. This is not the OSHA daily exam.

tools.name: desk_terms
tools.description: Published desk terms: what a buyer pays to ask, the ten free buyer files, the state seat, the seller introduction, how a fleet is quoted, and what grades A, B, and C mean. Returns only figures the site already states.

tools.name: list_request_choices
tools.description: Choices printed on the buyer request form, the dealer seat form, and the fleet form. The state names are options on the seat form. This tool does not submit a request.
